title: Lore Warden
summary: Challenge the Lore Warden's servants, then defeat the enraged warden.
overview: Challenge the Lore Warden's servants, then defeat the enraged warden.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Clear all three guardians and keep the fight within the hall.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The warden summons messenger drakes shortly after spawning and has a two-hour event lifetime.
Defiant dialogue summons two Guardians of the Past and a Sentinel of Antiquity.
Defeating all three removes the warden's protection and enlarges him for combat.
Leaving the permitted hall area causes a return and hate reset.

notes: Approval E367. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
